title: lasianthaea aurea
intro: Lasianthaea aurea, commonly known as the Golden Weed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Lasianthaea aurea include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating wounds, infections, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of Lasianthaea aurea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
